description: The main window's baseline capability set. `core:default` is what every Tauri v2 app is expected to carry; without it the ACL is empty and IPC is denied. Live-test 2026-10-27: `event.listen not allowed … core:event:allow-listen` appeared four times in crash-reports.jsonl because no capabilities directory existed at all, which broke the native Playback menu (src/hooks/useMenuPlayback.ts). core:default includes core:event:default, which grants allow-listen/allow-unlisten.
